text: {"rulings": [{"id": "1", "relation": "unrelated", "reason": "The auth mechanism and the dev server port are separate facts; choosing JWT says nothing about port 3000."}, {"id": "2", "relation": "unrelated", "reason": "Using JWT for auth and writing the stack in TypeScript are both true at once; neither contradicts the other."}, {"id": "3", "relation": "unrelated", "reason": "The database being Postgres is independent of the auth method; JWT tokens can be used alongside Postgres."}, {"id": "4", "relation": "unrelated", "reason": "Who the client is has nothing to do with how authentication is implemented."}, {"id": "5", "relation": "unrelated", "reason": "The JWT decision is a detail of the Meridian project but does not change or restate the fact that Joy is working on it."}]}
